For a connected positive-definite block, the strictly convex minimization defining C⁻¹e_j proves the solution is nonnegative by the absolute-value comparison. Congruence by diag(w) yields a connected positive-weight graph Laplacian, with kernel equal to the constants. A zero singleton also has nullity one. Thus Lw has one positive entry per positive-definite block and vanishes elsewhere.

The nondegenerate convex polygon thus has exactly one strict vertex per positive edge and one per positive-definite block.
